questions.question: In 2022, how many active COVID-19 emergency department diagnoses were reported by Sutter Amador Hospital?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_ed_volume_capacity.xlsx', sheet_name='ED_COMBINE_AL')
match = df[(df['FacilityName2'] == 'Sutter Amador Hospital') & (df['year'] == 2022) & (df['Category'] == 'Active COVID-19')]
result = int(match['EDDXCount'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Between John Muir Medical Center – Walnut Creek Campus and John Muir Medical Center – Concord Campus, which facility recorded more emergency department diagnoses for active COVID-19 in 2022?
questions.answer: John Muir Medical Center – Concord Campus
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_ed_volume_capacity.xlsx', sheet_name='ED_COMBINE_AL')
facilities = ['John Muir Medical Center – Walnut Creek Campus', 'John Muir Medical Center – Concord Campus']
sub = df[(df['FacilityName2'].isin(facilities)) & (df['year'] == 2022) & (df['Category'] == 'Active COVID-19')]
result = sub.sort_values(by='EDDXCount', ascending=False)['FacilityName2'].iloc[0]
questions.result: John Muir Medical Center – Concord Campus

questions.question: According to the 2022 records, is Valley Children's Hospital designated as operating within a primary care shortage area?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_ed_volume_capacity.xlsx', sheet_name='ED_COMBINE_AL')
val = df[(df['FacilityName2'] == "Valley Children's Hospital") & (df['year'] == 2022)]['PrimaryCareShortageArea'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if str(val).strip().lower() == 'yes' else 'no'
